label: Search synonyms: thesaurus > synonym collection > synonym document > synonym source
type: scheme, the full containment chain, never stated together on one source page - assembled here from separate statements across the synonyms/ subtree. A thesaurus (index-level, Server 8.0+) holds synonym collections, which hold synonym documents (unidirectional or bidirectional), which are referenced as a synonym source from a text field's mapping.
